description: Capture and resolve the nine Astra xhigh feature reviews of release/3.0 at fb5b59bd. Findings cover conformance, security boundaries, simplification, maintainability, authoring, and independent package quality. Full review reports are preserved in comments; child issues combine duplicate findings. Existing GitHub #79 Cowlib and #81 legacy notification follow-ups remain separate, as does the Jido Git-to-Hex release prerequisite. Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Review probes used current source with isolated processes; shared local build artifacts were stale v2, so final fixes require fresh matching v3 verification. Sequence: authorization and redaction defects first, then runtime/contract correctness, then authoring/docs and design improvements. No implementation is part of this intake.

comments.text:
Full independent review: Jido Connect v3 review: Connector DSL
Source task: 01a09c57-1cfa-7d40-bb71-a5688aa49672

Reviewed `release/3.0` at `fb5b59bda429b7545f82072dabe10f8b299432dc`. The checkout remained clean.

The confirmed defects are below, in priority order. Most require an invalid or conflicting declaration; I did not establish failures in existing provider actions.

1. **P2 — Legacy write declarations can omit confirmation.**  
   [spec/validator.ex:57](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/contracts/spec/validator.ex:57) checks `mutation?` but does not check write risk. A declaration with only `risk :external_write` produces `mutation?: false` and `confirmation: :none`. The current authorization function then returns `:ok` for an AI actor with `direct_mutation_mode: :deny`.  
   **Correction:** Validate risk, mutation, and confirmation together for both supported declaration forms.

2. **P2 — An auth default can expand the allowed profile list.**  
   [spec_builder.ex:288](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/dsl/spec_builder.ex:288) adds the default to the list before validation. With both profiles defined, `auth [:tenant], default: :other` produces `auth_profiles: [:other, :tenant]`. Runtime authorization uses this expanded list. The later membership check cannot detect the invalid declaration.  
   **Correction:** Require an explicit default to be a member of the declared list before normalization.

3. **P2 — Duplicate fields replace earlier constraints without an error.**  
   [schema.ex:12](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/schema.ex:12) uses `Map.new/1`. The Spark field entity has no uniqueness identifier. Declaring required string `:id`, followed by optional integer `:id`, accepts both `%{}` and `%{id: 3}`. The stored field list still contains both declarations. This also affects named schemas.  
   **Correction:** Reject duplicate field names before schema construction. Apply the same check to direct contract construction.

4. **P2 — Enum members and defaults can bypass the declared field type.**  
   [schema.ex:44](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/schema.ex:44) replaces the base type with `Zoi.enum/1`. An integer field with `enum: ["wrong"]` accepts `"wrong"` and exports a string schema. At [schema.ex:79](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/schema.ex:79), an integer field with `default: "wrong"` returns that string when input omits the field.  
   **Correction:** Validate enum members and defaults against the base type and its constraints before applying enum or default behavior.

5. **P2 — Different operation names can produce the same generated module.**  
   [projection_builder.ex:11](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/jido/projection_builder.ex:11) maps both `:foo_bar` and `:foo__bar` to `Actions.FooBar`. The projection check confirmed two different operation IDs with that same module. Spark checks the original names, so it does not detect this collision. The generator emits two definitions for one module. Sensors use the same naming method.  
   **Correction:** Check generated module names for duplicates before generating module code.

6. **P2 — Webhook validation accepts `kind: :none` when the map has another key.**  
   [operation_rules.ex:198](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/dsl/operation_rules.ex:198) compares complete maps. Thus, `verification %{kind: :none, header: "x-signature"}` passes. [spec/validator.ex:73](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/contracts/spec/validator.ex:73) repeats this check. This breaks the declaration requirement; it does not establish a bypass in provider webhook processing.  
   **Correction:** Check the `kind` value independently of other map keys. Reject a missing kind and `:none`.

7. **P2 — Generated provider packages do not register for catalog discovery.**  
   [provider_scaffold.ex:74](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/dev/provider_scaffold.ex:74) generates application settings with only `extra_applications`. [discovery.ex:19](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/catalog/discovery.ex:19) finds installed providers through `:jido_connect_providers`. Therefore, a generated package remains absent from normal discovery unless the host adds separate configuration. The scaffold test checks file contents but does not check registration.  
   **Correction:** Generate `env: [jido_connect_providers: [ProviderModule]]` in the package application settings.

8. **P3 — Mixed effect settings discard provider idempotency.**  
   [operation_rules.ex:149](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/dsl/operation_rules.ex:149) does not include top-level `provider_idempotency?` in its mixed-form check. An action with `effect :external_write, confirmation: :required_for_ai` and top-level `provider_idempotency? true` compiles with that value set to `false`.  
   **Correction:** Reject this combination and direct the author to put the option inside `effect`.

Two design improvements have concrete maintenance value:

- **P3 — Reduce repeated validation.** [build_spec.ex:14](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/dsl/transformers/build_spec.ex:14) runs operation rules before construction. The verifier runs them again, and `Spec.Validator` repeats several rules. The confirmation and webhook defects show why these paths need one shared rule definition.
- **P3 — Preserve field guidance in exported schemas.** [schema.ex:16](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/support/schema.ex:16) omits field descriptions and examples. They remain in `Field` records but disappear from generated JSON schemas. Copy this guidance into schema metadata so tool consumers can use it.

The focused checks also found two **upstream Zoi 0.18.7 limits**. Its enum parser ignores attached minimum constraints, while its JSON output includes them. Its enum JSON encoder always emits `"type": "string"`, including for `[1, 2]`. See [enum.ex:50](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/deps/zoi/lib/zoi/types/enum.ex:50) and [enum.ex:109](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/deps/zoi/lib/zoi/types/enum.ex:109). These need an upstream correction or a narrow Connect guard.

Cleanup order: fix effect and auth validation; fix field validation and name collisions; fix webhook checks and scaffold registration; then consolidate validation and preserve field guidance.

Coverage included all core DSL entities, sections, rule checks, spec construction, schema conversion, related contracts, generated projections, MCP declarations, authoring guides, scaffold code, and relevant tests and callers. `bw prime` and `git diff --check` completed.

Verification used current source in temporary processes with matching Spark and Zoi versions. The [Spark reproduction](/var/folders/8l/nyn2qp4d441b1zrgypxgry7m0000gn/T/jido-connect-dsl-review-pneymhj8/spark_review.exs) stops after spec construction. Saved build files contained Jido v2, so I did not use them to verify v3 adapters or rerun the full suite. No source, dependencies, branch state, issues, or packages were changed.

Full independent review: Jido Connect v3 review: Jido adapters
Source task: 01a09c57-1efd-7e03-b335-4810b34600d9

Reviewed `release/3.0` at `fb5b59bda429b7545f82072dabe10f8b299432dc`. The checkout is clean and unchanged.

**Confirmed defects**

1. **P1 — Catalog filters can replace the host policy.**  
   [input.ex:116](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/catalog/input.ex:116) accepts every atom key. [input.ex:71](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/catalog/input.ex:71) then merges filters after host runtime options.

   An action input with `filters: %{policy: nil}` removes a supplied deny policy. I reproduced this option replacement. `Catalog.call_tool/3` passes these options to Connect, where an absent policy permits operations with `host_policy_required?: false`. Existing catalog tests cover invalid filter shapes, but not runtime keys inside filters.

   **Smallest correction:** Permit only declared filter keys for both atom and string input. Reject runtime keys before the merge.

2. **P2 — Webhook sensor errors can expose secrets.**  
   [sensor_runtime.ex:63](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/jido/sensor_runtime.ex:63) converts the complete event to a string with `inspect/1`.

   If a caller passes an event containing `access_token`, the returned error includes its value. Later error serialization cannot redact it: the sanitizer only truncates strings. An isolated check retained `REVIEW_SENTINEL` in this error shape; structured input correctly redacted it. The existing sensor test passes only an atom.

   **Smallest correction:** Remove event contents from this unsupported-operation error. Keep the trigger ID, runtime mode, and event type.

3. **P2 — Generated availability loses the required-policy flag.**  
   [projection_builder.ex:28](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/jido/projection_builder.ex:28) copies policy names but omits `host_policy_required?`. Both projection structs also omit this field.

   Generated discovery passes these projections to `Authorization.connection_availability/4`. The missing flag defaults to `false`. Thus, a connected account with sufficient scopes can see `:available` when execution requires a host policy. This affects real declarations, including [Jira plan listing](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect_jira/lib/jido_connect/jira/actions/plans.ex:24). Execution still rejects the request through the complete specification.

   **Smallest correction:** Add the flag to action and sensor projections. Check that generated availability agrees with availability calculated from the specification.

4. **P2 — Adapter option lists discard supported runtime controls.**  
   [runtime_context.ex:81](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/jido/runtime_context.ex:81) omits `provider_client`. [catalog/input.ex:6](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/catalog/input.ex:6) omits both `provider_client` and `request_timeout_ms`.

   A host-supplied Jira client therefore reaches direct Connect calls but is lost through generated actions. Jira then selects its built-in client. Catalog calls also discard a host timeout that MCP-backed providers such as Trello use. I reproduced the catalog option loss. Existing provider tests demonstrate client injection through direct calls, but do not check adapter parity.

   **Smallest correction:** Forward these supported controls from trusted action context. Keep the common option list in one place and test the generated and catalog paths.

**Design improvements**

- **P2 — Put a complete v3 host example in the package guide.**  
  [README.md:310](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/README.md:310) presents `plugin_spec/1` as installation, although it returns discovery data. [README.md:601](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/README.md:601) says Jido schedules generated sensors, contrary to the current host contract.

  Also explain state assembly for the [suggested catalog routes](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/catalog/plugin.ex:12). Their actions return only catalog results. Pinned Jido uses that output as the complete next Agent state, so direct routing can lose other state or fail validation. Show a host wrapper that preserves domain state, and test it through `Agent.cmd/3`. [Pinned Agent execution contract](https://github.com/agentjido/jido/blob/b02052402a6f1c4be10098c2d560831f14daec58/lib/jido/agent/command/runner.ex#L120-L132)

- **P3 — Define how a host supplies fresh poll context.**  
  [sensor_runtime.ex:13](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/jido/sensor_runtime.ex:13) stores the initial context; each tick reuses it. Hosts must refresh short-lived leases, but the public callback guide gives no update operation. Document a supported context replacement step, or add a small helper that preserves the checkpoint. Scheduling and credential renewal should remain host responsibilities.

**Known upstream limits**

The catalog Plugin uses the correct pinned v3 `prepare/2` contract. Provider `.Plugin` modules are intentionally discovery modules. Generated sensors are intentionally process-free adapters. These distinctions are not defects. [Pinned Plugin contract](https://github.com/agentjido/jido/blob/b02052402a6f1c4be10098c2d560831f14daec58/lib/jido/plugin.ex#L52-L102)

The exact Git dependency for Jido remains the recorded publication constraint. I found no new upstream defect in this scope.

**Cleanup order:** Fix filter authority and error redaction first. Then restore metadata and option propagation. Finish the packaged host examples.

**Coverage:** Generated actions, projections, sensor callbacks, discovery filtering and availability, catalog Plugin, runtime context, and relevant callers/tests.

**Verification limits:** Local dependency folders and build files contain v2 versions. I downloaded the pinned v3 sources separately; Action and Signal archive checksums match the lockfile. I ran isolated option-merging and sanitizer checks. I did not run the full suite or validate the recorded quality results again.
